_comment: Declared inventory of every repository secret the workflows are allowed to reference.
NAMES AND PURPOSES ONLY. Never put a value in this file.
This file exists because actionlint cannot catch a typo'd or deleted secret: the
`secrets` context is an open map, so `secrets.APPSTORE_USERNAME` type-checks fine
even though that secret has never existed in this repository. It sat in deploy.yml
for months. scripts/check_secret_inventory.py cross-checks this file against the
workflows in both directions, so an undeclared reference and a stale declaration are
Declaring a secret here does NOT mean it is set. Run the 'Release secrets preflight'
workflow to see which of these are actually present on the repository.

secrets.name: APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12
secrets.purpose: RETIRED stale p12 from the abandoned signing path. The durable manual path deliberately uses the newly named APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_P12 so this value can never be trusted accidentally.
secrets.absent_note: retired — the manual path uses newly created, separately named assets

secrets.name: APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: RETIRED password known not to match APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12. Nothing may fall back to this stale pair.
secrets.absent_note: retired — nothing falls back to this

secrets.name: APPLE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: RETIRED profile from the abandoned signing path. Platform-specific profiles now have new secret names so this stale value cannot be selected.
secrets.absent_note: retired — the manual path uses newly created platform-specific profiles

secrets.name: APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_P12
secrets.purpose: Fresh Apple Distribution certificate and private key exported together as a password-protected p12. Used for manual iOS and macOS archive signing.

secrets.name: APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Export password for APPLE_DISTRIBUTION_CERTIFICATE_P12. Must be verified against the new p12 before enabling releases.

secrets.name: APPLE_IOS_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Fresh base64-encoded iOS App Store provisioning profile for com.sats21m.masonsbudget and team 384ZGKG4GB.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_APP_STORE_PROFILE
secrets.purpose: Fresh base64-encoded macOS App Store provisioning profile for com.sats21m.masonsbudget and team 384ZGKG4GB.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_P12
secrets.purpose: Fresh Mac Installer Distribution certificate and private key exported together as a password-protected p12 for the TestFlight pkg.

secrets.name: APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Export password for APPLE_MAC_INSTALLER_CERTIFICATE_P12. Must be verified against the new p12 before enabling releases.

secrets.name: ASC_API_KEY_P8
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API private key (.p8), base64-encoded. Used by altool instead of an Apple ID.

secrets.name: ASC_KEY_ID
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API key id.

secrets.name: ASC_ISSUER_ID
secrets.purpose: App Store Connect API issuer id.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64
secrets.purpose: Stable debug keystore so successive default-branch CI debug APKs share a signing identity and install over each other on the Fold. Required for default-branch APK artifacts; pull requests deliberately use Gradle's throwaway keystore.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Store password for ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard Android debug password.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS
secrets.purpose: Key alias inside ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard 'androiddebugkey'.

secrets.name: ANDROID_DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Key password inside ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Omit to use the standard Android debug password.

secrets.name: CONVEX_READ_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Read-only Convex credential baked into default-branch Android debug APKs so authenticated household rows work without manual phone entry. Pull-request builds must never receive it.
secrets.absent_note: Android debug APK falls back to sanitized fixtures with remote reads disabled
